I personally love them, they’re very simple to use. I do have sensitive ears so after a while they do get sore, but my ears get sore with AirPods and any normal earbuds anyway. They also do slip off my head when working out, granted I have to be looking down or something, which I believe any headphones would do. However as a girlie with long hair depending on how I wear it my hair does go with it when I’m taking them off, sometimes I don’t notice sometimes it wraps around and I have to unknot it or whatever. So be mindful of that, cause there is a gap between the head strap (idk what it’s called) and the part that covers your ears with the padding - that’s where my hair tangles and gets stuck. Also if you play them at a certain volume you can hear it. But I do love them, the color is pretty, I don’t regret it despite everything I said LOL

The plush padding and light fabric headband feel really nice. The ear cups feel amazing—they’re, without a doubt, my favorite thing about the headset. They are comfortable, and you can easily pop off the padding to replace them as needed. The AirPods Max plays the part of luxury headphones extremely well. The stainless steel headband and aluminum ear cups feel sturdy, and I don’t feel like they’ll break if I toss them in my backpack. All that metal means the AirPods Max is also really heavy, weighing in at 385 grams. That’s much heavier than the other top noise canceling headphones we’ve tested, and you feel it. That’s not to say these aren’t comfortable, though. The headband is brilliantly engineered to distribute the weight evenly. This allows you to mix and match colors, though you’ll have to shell out another $69 if you want to go that route. Great sound quality and battery life!!

Nice earphones. The sound quality is great, though I do wish the volume were a bit louder. They do make my outer ears ache from the pressure, but with some adjustment, they become comfortable again for a while. I mainly use them when I go shopping or to restaurants to block out background noise which can irritate me quickly and I listen to music and stories while I eat or shop because I have some sensory defense issues. While they don’t cancel out the noise, they drown it out enough for me to be at ease in my surroundings, generally. I saw these on a 2024 Black Friday deal for $69.99 and couldn’t pass them up. The Bluetooth is stable too and I haven’t had to charge them since I got them November (then again, I don’t use them heavily or daily), so the battery life for my light is them is more than adequate. I got these rose gold ones which are really pretty and girly.

I’ve wanted a pair of these for awhile cuz I literally listen to music 24/7 no matter where I’ll have it playing either over my Bluetooth speaker, my Bluetooth sound bars, or if I’m out an about I have it playing over my earbuds! With the way everyone was talking about these when they first came out I thought these were top notch and they were really good……….I really don’t know what all the hype was and an is all about with these?! Cuz honestly I don’t really care for these; like at all!! There’s no option for noise cancellation so therefore you can hear every little noise and the bass is just meh. The battery life is okay but not the best. If you’re on phone call the people on the other end can barely hear you so you feel like you’re screaming the whole time just to make sure they hear you. But the volume level is quite decent an impressive as far as if you were listening to music. I’m just going to give these to my son and return the other pair (I also bought a pair of the rose gold ones) %26 just stick to my $40 “onn” brand “bean” earbuds that are 100 times better then these are!

The sound is flat and quite unimpressive. Not what I had imagined at all. Which was clarity, and some bass level, with full coverage over my ears to keep outside noise to a low. Nope. Took them on a walk around the block, could hear the head set swooshing around every step of the way over the music. Disappointed!! I have the Beats ear buds, the wired ones. They are so much better that these Solo3. The ear muffler hurts my ear, they don’t fit quite right it’s weird. I tried with my son, and they said they seemed small. Save your money. I even bought a cheap pair for $18.99, figuring anything would be better. And you know what ? I was right! My 18.99 are AMAZING. I was shocked ! These are better than Beats Solo3 hands down. Get them before they’re gone, and at this price. I am confident you will not be let down !!

BUT the quality of the headphones itself SUCKS. Both sides of the headphones are broken. So now I have to secure it with tape and idk how but one side is stuck after taping it. I don’t think it’s made for thick kinky hair/locs. My sister and my cousin have experienced this. They no longer own theirs. If they ever sell these again or you’re thinking about getting a similar pair only get them on sale cuz they’ll break sooner or later.

However, I own a pair myself and I have to warn you if you have a big head, these will squeeze your ears until you have a headache and have to take them off. My ears last about 1 hour with these, then I have to take them off for relief. They do produce excellent sound though way better than Bose which I wanted to throw in the trash especially considering I paid about 2-3 times more for Bose and I might as well have bought a $30 pair of earphones for how bad that sound was. The Beats by Dr. Dre Solo3 is a solid choice for those who prioritize style and long battery life. It offers decent sound quality and a comfortable fit, making it a good option for everyday use.

However, if you're looking for the best possible sound quality or a more budget-friendly option, other headphones on the market might be a better fit. Pros:

Stylish design.
Long battery life.
Fast charging.
Good noise cancellation.
Comfortable to wear.

Cons:
Can be a bit bass-heavy for some.
Pricey compared to some competitors.

i haven't bought a pair of Beats because i just can't justify spending 300 dollars on a pair of headphones when i can get a cheap pair that works just as good. So when i saw these go on sale for 69, i couldn't pass it up as i was in the market for new headphones and have always wanted a pair.

i cant update after this but i just hope the battery lasts longer than it did today.

The audio doesn’t seem as compressed or at least seems to be a fuller sound than other headphones %26 AirPods.

My first pair is still functional %26 charging. I wear the headphones mowing, biking %26 exercising so the material on the ear pads have started to break down. Those can be replaced for 20$. I love how the battery life is long and don’t have to charge very often either! And what I love also is the built in microphone and that it comes with the cutest and soft case! It’s perfect for someone who wants the noise cancelling and not have ear buds in your ears but fit perfectly over your head I’m so happy they lowered the price!

Headphones fit great, with firm seal to keep out external noise and sound quality of music from library on phone to headphones more than adequate. I found the 'flat' setting on the phone produced very accurate sound so I'll just leave it set as is. And the price was more than fair for a great headphone product.

Very noise canceling. Sound is very clear! I love that they fold down into the case for better storage, they also charge so quick. Downfall I have found is I feel like they are not all that comfortable on my ears. These have an outstanding battery life but sadly I find it uncomfortable to wear them for too long. I don’t know for sure if it’s the product or because I’m used to wearing earbuds instead of headphones.

I’m very glad to have purchased these beats from this site as this color was the last one in stock anywhere (despite being from a 3rd party vendor but I’m not paying mind to it much since they seem to be reputable for their reputation and ratings). I had one issue with purchasing AppleCare since allegedly my exact pair was a previously bought item that was returned. And if you don’t know, Apple records the initial purchase date of all of their products, including Beats. Apple support luckily was able to modify the purchase date simply by seeing my proof of purchase and I was successfully able to attach AppleCare immediately after. So, while I was happy that I easily resolved a problem that others probably would have screwed themselves since the vendor wanted me to return the item for a refund and have me buy it again. Anyway, I’m in love with the color of my new headphones and they match perfect with any outfit I wear!

In a nutshell, the headphones are great. The sound quality is a good neutral range, with it being a rather flat in the frequency response, but with some extra sound in the treble. It’s not a bad thing, it’s more reminiscent of the Beats Solo Pro. That said though, in plain terms it means if you want a more bass heavy set of headphones, then this might not be the best for you. There isn’t any noise cancelling either, though personally I don’t mind too much as I don’t prefer active noise cancelling. There is spatial head tracking though, and it’s pretty fun to play with. I do like the case and how it’s pretty portable. It fits easily into a small backpack, and the battery life lasts as long as you do really. I listen to music frequently throughout the day, and I can honestly go a few days, specifically 3-4 depending on use, without needing to charge. I can see this also being good for traveling as well because of it. It’s also a nice looking pair of headphones, and built with quality materials. It feels sturdy on me, and while I mostly use it at home, I would feel comfortable walking with it places. Overall, I’d recommend for a decent daily driver headphone.

The sound quality is outstanding, it’s lightweight, very easy to link to my I phone and the function buttons are very easy to maneuver. It came with charger and protective carry case. THIS WAS MY BEST DEAL OF 2024. Merry Christmas to me!

The battery life is great and they connect instantly. They’re not too bulky, which I really like. The only downside is that wearing them for extended periods can get uncomfortable but honestly, I don’t listen for hours on end anyway, so it’s not a big deal for me.

I had asked her forever if she wanted me to get her a pair of these beats and she would always say she didn't want me to spend the money on them, well they went on a great sale so I bought them anyway. I’m mad and regret this purchase. The only good thing I can say about them is the audio is great and they’re only $99 if you wait for them to go on sale. But don’t pay full price for these. I bought these headphones about a month ago because I lost my Bose headphones somehow. Pros: -Good sound quality -Battery life has been great so far Cons: - They're pretty small. Both the size of the padding that goes around the ears and the length of the headphones themselves. I have a normal sized head and I wear glasses and the headphones are so tight that they press my glasses against the back of my ears which hurts. I can't wear them for more than an hour without feeling pain. It's not a problem if you don't wear glasses but just an FYI if you do. -I work from home and will listen to music on my phone and take calls from my laptop. The audio never automatically switches from my headphones to my laptop or vice versa, I always have to do it manually through Bluetooth settings which gets pretty annoying. Not sure if there is a way to change this but if there is, it's not very intuitive. I'll probably return these and look to upgrade to the bigger Beats or switch back over to Bose.

Very cute headphones. There are better headphones out there for audio quality, but I'm happy with it as a casual listener. You lose some sound with these as compared with the Pros, but I'm okay with that because these are better for your ear health. My main gripe is these headphones are very glitchy. They'll sometimes randomly disconnect from my laptop to connect to my phone or vice versa - even though I've been in range of both for a half hour and have not changed anything. It's particularly frustrating when this happens while I'm on a call. Plus the button to turn the headphones on/off is annoying - I wish you could just click it and not have to hold it down. And I wish the headphones turned off automatically when you fold them up - would save so much battery. Also, these headphones use a micro-USB charger, which is completely whack in this USB-C age. I hate having to keep another cord around JUST for my headphones. Overall these headphones are fine for the sale price (I bought for $115) but if I'd bought them at full price I'd be very upset.

They sounded okay. Liked the controls on the outer ear-piece. Connected to my Windows Laptop easily enough once I found how to change the settings to do so.

The band is really tight and hurt my ears especially where my glasses's arms are. Plus, even on sale, they were pricey.

I returned them and bought a different brand for half of that sale price. They fit nicely and much more comfortable. They sound as good, if not a bit better.

The sound quality of these is perfect. Whatever you are listening to comes through clear and distortion free. Noise cancellation is genius so that when I want to tune out and focus on a podcast or what have you it helps heighten the experience. Listening time and quick charge make these a really good item to have on the go. Very sturdy. Quality storage case for travel. Easy connect to Bluetooth. This pair happens to be my daughter’s. Hoping for my own soon.

I love these headphones! The sound is incredible! The fit is snuggle, so there’s no issue with fixing headphone positioning every time you move your head. I've not yet used the controls on the headphones besides powering on. Speaking of power the five minute full charge OMG! I have plenty of wireless earphones, earbuds without this feature, and let me just say from experience, that the charging speed is one of the most significant features!

I don’t usually have good luck with electronics so maybe my hopes were low. These are actually very nice.
They were packed so well and slick…nice quality.
I love the looks of them.. white and flat rose pink with pink metallic accents.
The operation is easy.. no finicky buttons that are hard to find yet they don’t “stick” out either.
Sound quality is perfect for my use. I listen to audio books and music while doing chores…. Good for me. Volume goes quite high without any noticeable distortion.
I read many reviews that say they are uncomfortable but I find them perfect. I can wear them hours with no issue. Maybe not for larger people … I’m 5’3 and do have a bit smaller hat size …
Speaking of hours… I charged these when I unpacked them last week and still have not had to recharge them…. Awesome battery life.
I got these on sale for $100 off and I’m so happy I did.

i love these beats so much they are so durable and i can fold them up without them breaking easily which is awesome. it’s so comfortable and i never want to take them off of my ears lol. the sound quality is really good and i can hear sm better and we’ll then when i use other headphones. i recommend these because they are just so cute and not only that but they are probably the best headphones out there if you ask me.

While searching for a set of wireless headphones to use with my Apple products, I decided to take a chance on the Beats Solo 3 headset, after seeing that it featured the W1 chip from Apple. Some people might be surprised to learn that Beats is part of the Apple ecosystem and their products are designed to work well with other Apple devices. This is my first Beats product, after using all of the AirPods earbuds for years. Setup of the headphones was quick and flawless, as you would expect from an Apple product. All I had to do was turn on the headset and hold it next to my iphone. A connect animation with a picture of my headset appeared on the screen. I spent over an hour listening to music at various sound levels, different styles and used only the headphones to access Siri, control music playback and block out the moderately noisy room I was in. I left my iphone in another room because I wanted to test the strength of the Bluetooth signal. after only one hour, I was very impressed. These headphones sat on my ears without hurting my head or making me uncomfortable. Although these headphones supposedly lack ANC (active noise canceling) I did not notice any of the ambient sounds around me when I wore the headphones. I had previously been using the AirPods Pro with ANC turned on all the time. These Beats Solo 3 headphones seemed to be just as effective at blocking out the ambient noises as my AirPods Pro were. It will take a little bit of time getting used to having a physical power button to turn on and off, compared to using the AirPods and slipping them into their recharge case when I am not using them. The carrying case for the Beats headphones is a tight fit for the headphones. I was a little worried about breaking the headphones when I took them out. But I was very careful and I was able to put the headphones away without breaking them. I am very satisfied with this headset. I highly recommend it to anyone who is looking for a reliable and high quality wireless headset for their Apple device.

The headphones themselves are amazing. The sound quality is great as to expect with Beats and the battery life is also one of the really good qualities of these headphones. My only complaint is that they start to hurt my ears after only about 30 minutes of wearing them. My mom also owns these headphones and has the same complaint. Only issue for me is the tight fit - I have a bigger head and these get tight after 2 hours. I got these for long plane rides and while I haven’t used them for this yet, I think they’ll work well.

Texture wise, it’s very light yet rich and absorbs very well leaving skin deeply nourished with hydration, it feels firmer and smoother in touch. New is always nicer. Beyond that I can’t say I’m all that impressed for what they cost. For me this purchase was a splurge. I debated about saving longer and getting the Bose headphones I really wanted. The Beats max volume is not very loud, all regulated. They squeeze my ears. Nice for not slipping off but ears are sore after. And no matter what I do or how I go about it the headband pulls my hair EVERY time and then can get so twisted I’m breaking hair to get them off. The third reason is that I love the rose gold color. The ear muffs on these are fairly small. They barely encompass my whole ear. Ok, that’s not a deal breaker, at least they stay on my head, right? That being said, they’re pretty solid. They have a good weight to them. They aren’t a lightweight, plastic material. I was impressed with that. The color is beautiful. If I could give accurate stars, 2.75 is what I would go with. Sound quality and noise cancellation are great for the price range. The construction overall is good. Overall score is 2.75 stars for me.
